io.name: clk
io.description: Clock input; counter advances on the positive edge.

io.name: reset
io.description: Active-high synchronous reset; when asserted at a positive clock edge, q is set to 0.

io.name: q
io.description: Decade counter output; counts 0 through 9 inclusive and wraps to 0 after 9.

functional_summary.overview: A 4-bit decade counter that counts from 0 through 9 inclusive with period 10. The active-high synchronous reset forces the counter to 0 on the rising clock edge. After 9, the counter wraps to 0.
rules: On each positive clock edge, if reset is high, q is set to 0.
On each positive clock edge, if reset is low and q is less than 9, q increments by 1.
On each positive clock edge, if reset is low and q equals 9, q wraps to 0.
The counter only assumes values 0 through 9 inclusive.
Output q updates with one clock cycle of latency relative to the sampled edge.
